title: [qt5-webengine] Build error

labels.name: category:port-bug
labels.description: The issue is with a library, which is something the port should already support

body:
**Host Environment**

- OS: Windows 11 22H2 2262819
- Compiler: MSVC2019 64 bit 14.34
-  vcpkg-tool version: 2022-11-10-5fdee72bc1fceca198fb1ab7589837206a8b81ba
- vcpkg-scripts version: 4cb4a5c5d 2022-11-18 (2 days ago)
- long file path for NTFS is `True`

**To Reproduce**

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

```powershell
.\vcpkg install sqlite3 libarchive qt5-webchannel qt5-webengine qt5-websockets --triplet=x64-windows --x-buildtrees-root=c:\v\
```

**Failure logs**
```powershell
error: building qt5-webengine:x64-windows failed with: BUILD_FAILED
error: Please ensure you're using the latest port files with `git pull` and `vcpkg update`.
Then check for known issues at:
    https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+in%3Atitle+qt5-webengine
You can submit a new issue at:
    https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/issues/new?template=report-package-build-failure.md&title=[qt5-webengine]+Build+error
Include '[qt5-webengine] Build error' in your bug report title, the following version information in your bug description, and attach any relevant failure logs from above.
    vcpkg-tool version: 2022-11-10-5fdee72bc1fceca198fb1ab7589837206a8b81ba
    vcpkg-scripts version: 4cb4a5c5d 2022-11-18 (2 days ago)
```

**Additional context**

Also fails moving the root folder to a new letter (can't be shorter!)
Also QT6 fails!
RAM ussage is fine, not swaping even (16GB with 8 CPU threads)
